Games/PelicansatClippers
Clippers 139Pelicans 123

Garland's 24 and 10 end the Clippers' seven-game skid

Final · Sun, Nov 8 · LA

LA beat New Orleans 139–123, a 16-point home win. The Clippers move to 2–7; the Pelicans fall to 4–6.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · How it went

Won the fourth quarter 37–28

Up 7 after three quarters, the Clippers won the fourth quarter 37–28 to win 139–123.

2 of 5 · Who carried it

Garland: 24 points and 10 assists

6 of 11 from the floor, 9 of 12 at the line, 14 by halftime.

3 of 5 · The Pelicans’ side

From the Pelicans’ side.

Lost the fourth quarter 28–37, the stretch that decided it.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it inside and from three

Points in the paint 60–52; assists 34–23. L.A. had a season-low 11 turnovers.

5 of 5 · What it meant

Clippers 139, Pelicans 123.

The Clippers move to 2–8, 13th in the West. The Pelicans fall to 4–8, 12th in the West.

2 · The play of the game

Sanders for the lead.

Kobe Sanders' three-pointer with 2:23 left in the third quarter that put the Clippers ahead 94–93; they never trailed again.
